entries.clue: Walled realm of the gods, its ramparts raised by a cheated giant mason
Bloated barrow-dweller that rises by night to guard its buried hoard
Sweet run of notes from a doorbell, or from the tower at quarter past
Wide sweep of hills and sky, or the sideways way to hold a page
Shrill summons set the night before to haul you out of bed
Between lunch and teatime, when the eyelids get heavy
Twelve at night, when one day quietly hands over to the next
Perforated strip wound in a canister, ruined by a carelessly opened door
Barrel of curved glass through which the world arrives upside down
Gritty silver texture prized by purists; its digital cousin is noise
God who laid his hand in a wolf's jaws as surety, and lost it when the bond held
Red-lit den where pictures swim up out of trays of chemicals
Angular mark cut in stone or bone, carrying spells and the names of the dead
Giant wolf bound by a ribbon made of impossible things, waiting to swallow a god
